meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 做 git 操作前会先判断模式:提交时按目录和关注点把多文件改动拆成多个原子提交,并沿用仓库已有的语言和提交风格;也能改写历史(rebase/squash),以及查明某段改动是何时由哪个提交引入的。
howto.when: 当你提到 “commit”、“rebase”、“squash” 等关键词,或要求查找某段改动的来源时触发。

say.text: 把这些改动提交,按模块拆成多个原子提交
say.note: 会先分析仓库提交风格再拆分

say.text: 用 rebase 把最近几个提交压成一个
say.note: 会先判断分支是否已推送

say.text: 查一下这行代码是哪个提交、什么时候加的

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude picks a mode before git work: it splits multi-file changes into atomic commits matching the repo's style, rewrites history (rebase/squash), and finds when a change was introduced.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention “commit”, “rebase”, “squash” or similar, or ask where a specific change came from.

say_en.text: Commit these changes, split into atomic commits by module
say_en.note: It first detects the repo's commit style

say_en.text: Squash the last few commits with rebase
say_en.note: It checks first whether the branch was pushed

say_en.text: Which commit added this line, and when?
